label: early-sequence accumulator of h/1/v/j/m/k/b inputs (peaks at <DEL> of short sequences)
explanation: Graded evidence-accumulator over the first few steps. Never active at t=0; rate peaks at t=2-4 and falls off sharply after t=5 (copy phase holds only 12% of mass). Fires when a large share of the inputs so far are from the set {h, 1, v, j, m, k, b} (h strongest: prev_tok=h gives 4x lift, first_tok=h 2.8x); other tokens (e.g. d, r, e, w, c) appear to dilute or suppress it. The largest activations are at the <DEL> step of short sequences (L=3-4) whose originals contain h (e.g. b h <DEL>), and <DEL> carries 29% of mass overall; shorter L raises the rate. Predicate (step 1-5 and at least half the prior inputs in the set) reaches F1 ~0.42 / mass recall ~0.67 on dev; the boundary is soft because the unit behaves like a weighted token sum rather than a crisp condition. Weak residual firing in late copy steps is not captured.
